title: Sample issue for template checks
complaint: Customer reports the export fails for orders over 500 lines.
reproSteps: Create an order with 500+ line items.

rootCause.hypothesis: The export job times out serializing more than 500 rows.

blastRadius: Any customer exporting an order with more than 500 line items.

proposedFix.description: Stream the export instead of buffering it in memory.
proposedFix.risks: Streaming changes the export's error-handling path.

openQuestions: Is 500 lines the exact threshold, or does it vary by column count?
